name: 33496 · Boca Raton, FL
findings: ZIP 33496 (Boca Raton) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33496 (Boca Raton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33496 (Boca Raton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

observations.text: 74 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
